DECLARE

 SELECT company

 FROM contracts
 WHERE contract_id = temp_buffer AND 
 contract_type = 'RG' AND 
 LAB_COMMON.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(contract_id, :global.chapter_id) = 'Y' AND --MLT 250 Code changes - As user able to select contract id linked with chapter id

 ;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_ALL_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Initial Master Block Cusing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) IN('CHANGED','INSERT') ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Cursor_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to commit the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT);
 --
 -- If user cancels commit dialog, raise error
 --
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --
 -- Clear all the detail blocks for this master without
 -- any further asking to commit.
 --
 currel := Get_Block_Property(trigblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 curdtl := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 IF Get_Block_Property(curdtl, STATUS) <> 'NEW' THEN
 Go_Block(curdtl);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
 IF :System.Block_Status <> 'NEW' THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- Put cursor back where it started
 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 END IF;
 RAISE;

END Clear_All_Master_Details;

 lv_chapters_CSV VARCHAR2(4000);
 indx VARCHAR2(30);
BEGIN
 IF :CHAPTERS.SELECT_ALL = 'Y' THEN
 :CTRL_BLK_1.S_CHAPTER_ID := NULL;
 ELSE
 indx := pkg_multiselect.CHAPTERS_LIST.FIRST;
 lv_chapters_CSV := NULL;
 pkg_multiselect.selected_chapters_cnt := 0;
 loop
 --message('indx ' || indx);
 exit when indx is null;
 pkg_multiselect.selected_chapters_cnt := pkg_multiselect.selected_chapters_cnt + 1;
 IF pkg_multiselect.CHAPTERS_LIST(indx) = 1 THEN
 if lv_chapters_CSV IS NULL THEN
 lv_chapters_CSV := indx;
 else
 lv_chapters_CSV := lv_chapters_CSV || ',' || indx;
 end if;
 END IF; 
 
 indx := pkg_multiselect.CHAPTERS_LIST.NEXT(indx);
 end loop;
 
 pkg_multiselect.SELECTED_CHAPTERS_CSV := lv_chapters_CSV; -- used to query batch block 
 
 IF pkg_multiselect.selected_chapters_cnt = 0 THEN
 MESSAGE('Select chapter');pause;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSIF pkg_multiselect.selected_chapters_cnt = 1 THEN
 :CTRL_BLK_1.S_CHAPTER_ID := pkg_multiselect.SELECTED_CHAPTERS_CSV; 
 ELSIF pkg_multiselect.selected_CHAPTERS_cnt > 1 THEN
 :CTRL_BLK_1.S_CHAPTER_ID := NULL;
 disp_item('CTRL_BLK_1.LBL_MULTI_CHAPTERS','Y'); 
 END IF; 
 END IF;

 
 GO_ITEM('CTRL_BLK_1.S_CHAPTER_ID');
 EXECUTE_TRIGGER('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
 
 
END;

PROCEDURE populate_batch_inputs_lov IS
 lv_where VARCHAR2(4000);

 lv_batch_subquery VARCHAR2(4000);
BEGIN
 :ctrl_blk_1.selected_chapters_csv := pkg_multiselect.selected_chapters_csv;
 
 lv_chapter_subquery :=
 ' ( SELECT TRIM(regexp_substr(NVL(:ctrl_blk_1.selected_chapters_csv, chapter_id), ''[^,]+'', 1, level))
 FROM dual
 CONNECT BY regexp_substr(NVL(:ctrl_blk_1.selected_chapters_csv, chapter_id), ''[^,]+'', 1, level) IS NOT NULL
 ) '; 
 
 
 lv_batch_subquery := '(
 SELECT
 batch_id
 FROM
 units 
 WHERE

 AND chapter_id IN ' || lv_chapter_subquery || '
 AND qc_test_date IS NULL
 ) ';
 
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id IS NOT NULL

 THEN
 lv_where := '
 contract_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_contract_id
 AND chapter_id = NVL(:ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id, chapter_id)
 AND substr(batch_id, 8, 2) = ''RG'' 
 AND ( (:CTRL_BLK_7.SEARCH IS NOT NULL AND batch_id LIKE ''%'' || :CTRL_BLK_7.SEARCH || ''%'')
 OR
 :CTRL_BLK_7.SEARCH IS NULL
 ) 
 AND batch_id IN ' || lv_batch_subquery ;
 
 ELSE

 
 lv_where := '

 AND chapter_id IN ' || lv_chapter_subquery ||
 ' AND substr(batch_id, 8, 2) = ''RG'' 
 AND ( (:CTRL_BLK_7.SEARCH IS NOT NULL AND batch_id LIKE ''%'' || :CTRL_BLK_7.SEARCH || ''%'')
 OR
 :CTRL_BLK_7.SEARCH IS NULL
 ) 
 AND batch_id IN ' || lv_batch_subquery; 
 
 

 END IF;
 
 lv_order_by := 'to_date(substr(batch_id, 0, 6), ''mmddyy'') ASC , INSERT_DATS ASC' ;
 
 
 
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('BATCH_INPUTS', DEFAULT_WHERE, lv_where);
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('BATCH_INPUTS', ORDER_BY, lv_order_by);

 GO_BLOCK('BATCH_INPUTS');
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '25';
 execute_query;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '0';
END;

FUNCTION lov_batch_count RETURN NUMBER IS
 batch_count NUMBER;
BEGIN
 
 IF pkg_multiselect.selected_chapters_csv IS NULL AND :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id IS NOT NULL THEN
 pkg_multiselect.selected_chapters_csv := :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id;
 END IF;
 
 SELECT
 COUNT(1) into batch_count
 FROM
 batch_inputs
 WHERE
 contract_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_contract_id
 AND chapter_id IN (
 SELECT
 TRIM(regexp_substr(NVL(pkg_multiselect.selected_chapters_csv, chapter_id), '[^,]+', 1, level))
 FROM
 dual
 CONNECT BY
 regexp_substr(NVL(pkg_multiselect.selected_chapters_csv, chapter_id), '[^,]+', 1, level) IS NOT NULL
 )
 AND substr(batch_id, 8, 2) = 'RG'
 AND batch_id IN (
 SELECT
 ui.batch_id
 FROM
 units ui
 WHERE
 ui.contract_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_contract_id
 AND ui.chapter_id IN (
 SELECT
 TRIM(regexp_substr(NVL(pkg_multiselect.selected_chapters_csv, chapter_id), '[^,]+', 1, level))
 FROM
 dual
 CONNECT BY
 regexp_substr(NVL(pkg_multiselect.selected_chapters_csv, chapter_id), '[^,]+', 1, level) IS NOT NULL
 )
 AND ui.qc_test_date IS NULL
 );
 
 RETURN batch_count;
 
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN 0;
 
END;

PROCEDURE enable_disable_item(p_item_name in varchar2,p_mode in varchar2) IS
 it_id item ;
BEGIN
 it_id := find_item(p_item_name) ;
 IF Id_Null(it_id) THEN 
 Message('No such item: '||p_item_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 else
 IF p_mode = 'E' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(p_item_name, ENABLED) = 'FALSE' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(p_item_name, ENABLED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(p_item_name, NAVIGABLE, PROPERTY_TRUE) ;
 END IF; 
 ELSIF p_mode = 'D' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(p_item_name, ENABLED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(p_item_name, ENABLED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(p_item_name, NAVIGABLE, PROPERTY_FALSE) ;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 end if;
END;
